_about: Permanent scouting notes learned from post-fight reviews (round-by-round reports, scorecards, recaps, and Suleman's own fight notes). Each note only counts for fights AFTER its date. Tags feed the engine's 'Scouting notes' signal. Add, never rewrite history.

notes.event: OKTAGON 94: Eckerlin vs. Kozma
notes.note: Took Christian Eckerlin down about a minute in, held top position for most of R1, then took the back and finished a rear-naked choke at 4:58.

notes.event: OKTAGON 94: Eckerlin vs. Kozma
notes.note: Taken down early by David Kozma and couldn't get back up in almost four minutes; he cut Kozma from the bottom but gave up his back and tapped to an RNC at 4:58 of R1. His third stoppage loss in his last four fights.

notes.event: OKTAGON 94: Eckerlin vs. Kozma
notes.note: Dropped Christian Jungwirth in R1 (left hand) and R2 (right hook) and won a unanimous decision while fighting through a knee injury from camp.

notes.event: OKTAGON 94: Eckerlin vs. Kozma
notes.note: Knocked down in R1 and R2 by Max Coga but recovered both times, hurt Coga's lead leg with low kicks and pressed hard in R3. Lost a close unanimous decision (29-28, 30-27, 29-28) in the Fight of the Night.

notes.event: OKTAGON 94: Eckerlin vs. Kozma
notes.note: Aged 41 and back from retirement after 469 days out, he took the unbeaten Frederic Vosgröne down repeatedly, defended his leg-lock attempts and finished with ground and pound at 4:50 of R2 (sig. strikes 89-13 per Wetterauer Zeitung). The layoff didn't show.

notes.event: OKTAGON 94: Eckerlin vs. Kozma
notes.note: First pro loss. His takedown attempts against Karlos Vémola ended with him on his back, he was taken down again in R2 and stopped by ground and pound at 4:50. His first opponent with a top-level résumé (previous five opponents went in 7-1, 6-2, 6-7, 0-0 and 1-0).

notes.event: OKTAGON 94: Eckerlin vs. Kozma
notes.note: Used takedowns to control Marc Diakiese, landing hard elbows from top and nearly finishing an RNC in R1. Won 30-27 on all three cards against a UFC veteran.

notes.event: OKTAGON 94: Eckerlin vs. Kozma
notes.note: Controlled on the ground by Fedor Duric in R1 (elbows, near RNC) and lost every round 30-27. His takedown defence held up better in R2.

notes.event: OKTAGON 94: Eckerlin vs. Kozma
notes.note: Stand & Bang (striking-only) rules, not MMA: dropped Dominic Schober three times for a TKO at 2:53 of R1 in his first bout in small gloves. Appeared to hurt his hand.

notes.event: OKTAGON 94: Eckerlin vs. Kozma
notes.note: Stand & Bang (striking-only) rules: dropped three times by debutant Edmon Avagyan and stopped at 2:53 of R1. Follows KO/TKO losses to Daniel Ligocki (2025) and Andreas Gustafsson (2023).

notes.event: OKTAGON 94: Eckerlin vs. Kozma
notes.note: Knocked out Hugo Vach (8-1, on a five-fight win streak) with one hard right hand in R1 after a five-minute power cut. His earlier stoppage losses were all submissions, not strikes.

notes.event: OKTAGON 94: Eckerlin vs. Kozma
notes.note: First stoppage loss: KO'd by one hard right hand from Deniz Ilbay in R1 (2:23). His five-fight streak came against opponents who went in 5-1, 3-0, 2-1, 1-0 and 3-0.

notes.event: OKTAGON 94: Eckerlin vs. Kozma
notes.note: Chopped Robert Pukač's lead leg with low kicks, shook off a brief takedown and closed his left eye with punches for a TKO at 3:55 of R1. His fifth straight finish.

notes.event: OKTAGON 94: Eckerlin vs. Kozma
notes.note: Stopped in R1 by Jaime Cordero's leg kicks and punches; his left eye swelled shut (fightlive.sk reports a likely orbital fracture). His first stoppage loss in his last ten fights; check his injury status before his next booking.

notes.event: OKTAGON 94: Eckerlin vs. Kozma
notes.note: Caught Nikola Janković's takedown attempt in a triangle choke off his back at 1:24 of R1. Now 6-0 with every win in R1, four of them by submission.

notes.event: OKTAGON 94: Eckerlin vs. Kozma
notes.note: Shot a takedown on Tamerlan Dulatov and got caught in a triangle at 1:24 of R1, his first fight in 602 days.

notes.event: OKTAGON 94: Eckerlin vs. Kozma
notes.note: Swept all three rounds on all three cards (30-27 x3) against 13-6 veteran Roman Paulus, and stays unbeaten at 10-0. Better late again.

notes.event: OKTAGON 94: Eckerlin vs. Kozma
notes.note: Dropped the unbeaten Oskar Staszczak early and finished him with follow-up punches at 1:04 of R1. He climbed the cage to celebrate before the referee had stopped it and had to come back to finish.

notes.event: UFC Fight Night: Rosas Jr. vs. Barcelos
notes.note: Lost 29-28 x3 to Ailin Perez despite out-landing her 46-37 in significant strikes; 4 of 6 media scores (MMADecisions) had Dumont winning. The loss is closer than the record shows.

notes.event: UFC Fight Night: Rosas Jr. vs. Barcelos
notes.note: Won R1 and R3 on control (3:41 vs 0:40) while being out-landed 37-46. Official 29-28 x3, but 4 of 6 media scored it for Norma Dumont. A thin win.

notes.event: UFC Fight Night: Rosas Jr. vs. Barcelos
notes.note: Submitted by a standing guillotine at 0:57 of R1 by two-days'-notice replacement Luis Hernandez. His third straight submission loss (McVey, Donte Johnson, Hernandez).

notes.event: UFC Fight Night: Rosas Jr. vs. Barcelos
notes.note: Won the TUF 34 strawweight final: floored the unbeaten Melissa Amaya with two right hands in R1, then dropped her again with a right hook and multi-punch burst and finished her with hammerfists at 3:19 of R2.

notes.event: UFC Fight Night: Rosas Jr. vs. Barcelos
notes.note: First pro loss: dropped by two right hands in R1 and stopped in R2 by Tina Black's punches.

notes.event: UFC Fight Night: Rosas Jr. vs. Barcelos
notes.note: Gave up his back while rolling in R2; Brady Hiestand locked a body triangle and finished a rear-naked choke at 4:07.

notes.event: UFC Fight Night: Rosas Jr. vs. Barcelos
notes.note: Dropped Christian Edwards with a left hook in R1 and hunted an RNC, but Edwards took R2 on two of Sherdog's three cards and floored him with a left hook for a TKO at 1:47 of R3. He faded after a strong first round.

notes.event: UFC Fight Night: Rosas Jr. vs. Barcelos
notes.note: Got early takedowns on Elves Brener but faded, then faceplanted from a right hook and was stopped at 4:14 of R1. His second straight R1 KO/TKO loss (Jacobe Smith, Feb 2026).

notes.event: UFC Fight Night: Rosas Jr. vs. Barcelos
notes.note: Took Montel Jackson down in R1, but was dazed by repeated one-twos and stopped at 2:39 of R2. His second KO/TKO loss since 2023 (Song Yadong).

notes.event: UFC Fight Night: Rosas Jr. vs. Barcelos
notes.note: Won R1 and R2 on the feet with leg kicks and stance switches, then was taken down twice in R3 and lost a split decision. All 7 media scores (MMADecisions) had him winning 29-28, so treat the loss as a robbery, not decline.

notes.event: UFC Fight Night: Rosas Jr. vs. Barcelos
notes.note: Trailed after two rounds but two R3 takedowns swung two judges for a split decision over John Castaneda. Every media scorer (7 of 7) had Castaneda, so the win flatters him.

notes.event: UFC Fight Night: Rosas Jr. vs. Barcelos
notes.note: Pinned to the fence and knocked out by Yazmin Jauregui's hooks at 1:02 of R1, her first KO/TKO loss.

notes.event: UFC Fight Night: Rosas Jr. vs. Barcelos
notes.note: Taken down easily by Rodolfo Vieira and accepted bottom position; low energy through rounds 1–2. Lost 30-27 on all three cards even though he was better on the feet in round 3.
notes.source: Suleman's fight notes; UFC.com official scorecards

notes.event: UFC Fight Night: Rosas Jr. vs. Barcelos
notes.note: Took Robert Bryczek down at will and banked rounds 1–2 on control; unanimous 30-27 win against a heavy-handed striker.
notes.source: Suleman's fight notes; UFC.com official scorecards

notes.event: UFC Fight Night: Rosas Jr. vs. Barcelos
notes.note: Lost the TUF 34 bantamweight final by disqualification (illegal knee, R1 2:19). He wasn't beaten in the fight itself — the model treats it as a non-competitive result, not a real loss.

notes.event: UFC Fight Night: Rosas Jr. vs. Barcelos
notes.note: Won the TUF 34 final by disqualification (illegal knee from Osmanli, R1 2:19). Not counted as a competitive win.

notes.event: UFC Fight Night: Rosas Jr. vs. Barcelos
notes.note: Went deep into a five-round main event and still finished Raoni Barcelos (TKO, R5 1:38). The gas tank holds up over 25 minutes.

notes.event: UFC Fight Night: Rosas Jr. vs. Barcelos
notes.note: Took Rosas into the fifth round before a late TKO at age 39. His résumé going in — five straight UFC wins over Payton Talbott (11-0), Cody Garbrandt, Ricky Simon and Montel Jackson — deserved more weight than the age-curve read gave it.

notes.event: UFC Fight Night: Rosas Jr. vs. Barcelos
notes.note: Stopped Rodolfo Bellato with punches late (TKO R3 1:47) as a clear underdog — finishing power holds into round 3.

notes.event: UFC Fight Night: Rosas Jr. vs. Barcelos
notes.note: KO'd Vanessa Demopoulos with punches in 62 seconds.

notes.event: UFC Fight Night: Rosas Jr. vs. Barcelos
notes.note: Standing guillotine finish of Sedriques Dumas in 57 seconds on his UFC debut.

notes.event: UFC Fight Night: Rosas Jr. vs. Barcelos
notes.note: Rear-naked choke of Rinya Nakamura (R2 4:07).

notes.event: UFC Fight Night: Rosas Jr. vs. Barcelos
notes.note: KO'd Ricky Simon with punches (R2 2:39).

notes.event: UFC Fight Night: Rosas Jr. vs. Barcelos
notes.note: TKO of Josiah Harrell with a punch (R1 4:14).

notes.event: UFC 331: Van vs. Pantoja 2
notes.note: Gassed from round 2 against Tai Tuivasa and scraped a split decision.

notes.event: UFC 331: Van vs. Pantoja 2
notes.note: Body work and kicks opened Doo Ho Choi up; overhand right finished it in R1. Veteran finishing power is real.

notes.event: UFC 331: Van vs. Pantoja 2
notes.note: Stopped in R1 by Pitbull; now has multiple KO losses.

notes.event: UFC 331: Van vs. Pantoja 2
notes.note: Was losing R1 on the ground to Eduarda Moura, then found a belly-down armbar at 3:22.
